drafts.title: Fork
drafts.pitch: The user forks the conversation, and now there are two of everyone, including two equally tired Tildes.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 9, in-world 8, fresh 7. The silent split room with two Cursors waving across the line is a nice visual and the Tilde close lands, but the doubled-tiredness payoff is predictable and Cursor does nothing of its own.

drafts.title: Cached
drafts.pitch: Null's answers get faster once they're cached, until Cursor wonders what the user actually asked.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 6, in-world 8, fresh 7. A good escalation of Null answering before the ring, but 'cached' needs explaining, the pre-answered weather reads ambiguously, and Null's eye sliding away echoes recent Null closers.
